clauses.title: Chemical Composition
clauses.content: Carbon content shall not exceed 0.20% for Grade E250 Quality A, with Carbon Equivalent (CE) max 0.42%.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength and Yield Stress
clauses.content: Minimum yield stress for Grade E250 is 250 MPa for thickness < 20 mm; minimum tensile strength is 410 MPa with 23% elongation.
